notes.title: New Game "Zaam"
notes.notes:
Hey everyone

Our new Game "Zaam" is moving along great you can wishlist it on steam:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1128220/ZAAM

updates at:​ @alonzubin​

notes.title: Working on a spiritual successor
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, a short update

First of all we would like to thanks this amazing community
on its warm welcome.

Before we published our game at steam we didn't know how the community would receive it's always monday. after seeing the good response of the community that embraced the game, good comments, reviews and lets plays.

We decided to create a spiritual successor,
as part of this development we are monetizing "it's always monday"
in hope of supporting the new game develop process.

In any case you can still find the game for free at "gamejolt" or "itch.io"
More updates are coming soon.

Thanks
Alon
